outcome: Quantitative static and dynamic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) measurements of pelvic floor changes
cohort: 51 primiparous women (30 vaginal delivery, 21 elective cesarean delivery)
finding: Pelvic floor recovery primarily occurred during the early phase after delivery in both groups.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean delivery had a non-significant protective effect on postpartum pelvic floor structure and function compared to vaginal delivery.
